title: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 13.7.0 before 19.4.11, 19.5 before 19.5.9,…
description: A vulnerability in GitLab CE/EE versions from 13.7.0 before 19.4.11, 19.5 before 19.5.9, and 19.6 before 19.6.2 allowed authenticated users with Maintainer-role permissions to potentially obtain another user's authenticated session cookie. This issue was due to improper session storage handling in the dependency proxy authentication flow when a redirect-pending state was triggered. The vulnerability could lead to unauthorized access to another user's account.
